scope_definition: Audit remediation implementation only: accepted still-live defects/bad corrections. Ordinary unfinished Stage 5 feature delivery remains preserved in the roadmap but is not counted as a remediation unit.

excluded_current_defect_groups.reason: Documentation-only; completed in Phase 4 Series 1/3 synchronization.

accepted_bad_correction_records.not_rescheduled_reason: Later fixes/current contracts already supersede or restore these behaviors, or their remaining external boundary is Stage 6.

preserved_non_remediation_stage5_work.work: JOB-04 retry/terminal-failure and JOB-06 persistent reconciliation/observability.

derivation.preserved_non_remediation_reason: These are real roadmap obligations, but they are not accepted audit defects or still-live bad corrections. This bounded remediation plan must not turn unfinished planned functionality into audit defects.

series.name: Translation local/CI correctness without DB schema

units.title: Remove the implicit zero-stale real-pack gate
units.observable_defect: The test still requires validateTranslationPacks(manualTranslationPacks) to return exactly { staleKeys: {} }, turning an allowed stale condition into an implicit merge gate.
units.desired_invariant: Real manual packs may contain stale entries; stale values are surfaced/excluded and fallback continues. No requirement to restore the removed synthetic canary.
units.smallest_safe_change_boundary: Test/policy assertion only. Remove or narrow the exact-empty staleKeys requirement without changing runtime stale classification/fallback semantics.
mandatory_tests: Focused app/localization/resources.test.ts coverage for stale classification/fallback
pnpm test
non_goals: Do not restore the historical synthetic stale canary solely for audit symmetry.
Do not introduce strict stale-blocking CI without a new explicit policy decision.

units.title: Use own-property canonical namespace validation in bundle compilation
units.observable_defect: bundles.ts uses property lookup on canonicalEnglishCatalog, so inherited Object.prototype names can be treated as namespaces even though sources.ts already uses Object.hasOwn.
units.desired_invariant: Only own canonical catalog namespaces are accepted by bundle compile/verify paths.
units.smallest_safe_change_boundary: Align bundle scope/descriptor lookup with the existing own-property guard used by translation sources; add prototype-key regressions.
mandatory_tests: app/localization/bundles.test.ts must reject inherited names such as constructor/toString
pnpm test
non_goals: Do not redesign catalog shape or translation-source priority.
Do not add new namespaces.

units.title: Stop double-counting one invalid-origin persistent row
units.observable_defect: An invalid-origin physical row can be inspected by both manual and machine adapters and each adapter can report the same invalid-origin issue.
units.desired_invariant: One physical invalid-origin row contributes one telemetry issue while remaining unpublished; translation selection semantics stay unchanged.
units.smallest_safe_change_boundary: Confine the change to persistent-source row classification/reporting. Do not alter valid manual/machine precedence or store schema.
mandatory_tests: A combined manual+machine source regression proving one malformed invalid-origin row is reported once and never published
Existing malformed-row aggregation tests
pnpm test

viable_options: Validate/partition rows once before origin-specific adapters consume them.
Assign deterministic single reporting ownership for invalid-origin rows while both adapters skip them.
Deduplicate at a request-local issue aggregation boundary using stable physical-row identity.
decision_criteria: No change to valid source precedence

non_goals: Do not suppress invalid-origin telemetry entirely.
Do not change persistent-row selection semantics.

units.title: Enforce canonical-English exclusion including whitespace-wrapped identity
units.observable_defect: Accepted storage constraints and production verification use lower(locale) without trimming for English comparison, so whitespace-wrapped English identity can bypass the non-English storage invariant.
units.desired_invariant: Persistent UI translation and bundle rows reject canonical English identity after trimming/canonical comparison; production verification detects the same invalid state.
dependencies: Accepted migration history remains immutable; correction must be a new forward migration after 0010.
units.smallest_safe_change_boundary: Add one forward migration that tightens the two storage constraints, mirror the invariant in db/schema.ts, and align repository-owned verification. Do not rewrite 0002.
mandatory_tests: New PostgreSQL integration coverage that whitespace-wrapped English is rejected for both translation and bundle storage
Existing valid canonical non-English rows still migrate/read
pnpm db:check
pnpm db:test

units.db_gate_reason: Touches PostgreSQL CHECK invariants, forward migration history, schema mirror, and DB integration behavior.
non_goals: Do not edit accepted migration 0002.
Do not silently delete existing invalid data as part of the audit fix.
Do not perform external migration rollout or production verification.

units.title: Restore fresh-plan A→B→A stale-identity reactivation
units.observable_defect: upsertPending returns an existing stale task unchanged when its generation is no longer the current generation, so a later fresh A after A→B cannot become current again.
units.desired_invariant: A fresh planner decision may reactivate eligible stale A after A→B while old Queue delivery cannot self-reactivate, completed identity remains terminal, and generation/claim/publication fencing remains monotonic and safe.
dependencies: Preserve the existing generation-head serialization point and claim/publication fencing.
REM-02/REM-04 do not block this unit but should be completed before broad persisted-bundle remediation is considered complete.
units.smallest_safe_change_boundary: Change only fresh-planning/store semantics and the minimum persistence representation needed to distinguish a new planning occurrence from stale delivery. Consumer delivery semantics remain terminal for stale/completed tasks.
mandatory_tests: Database integration: A planned/current → B planned/current → old A becomes stale → fresh A plan becomes current/claimable
Old stale Queue delivery remains terminal without planner action
Completed A is not reopened
Generation head remains monotonic under concurrent planning
Claim/publication fencing regressions remain green
pnpm test
pnpm db:test
Green GitHub Actions database job on the actual implementation PR head
units.db_gate_reason: Changes durable PostgreSQL task-planning/ordering behavior and may require persistence/schema changes depending on mechanism.

viable_options: Reuse the existing stable task row but assign a new current generation during a fresh planner reactivation.
Represent a fresh planning occurrence separately from stable task identity while retaining the stable identity contract.
Introduce another minimal durable occurrence/version marker only if existing generation semantics cannot express the invariant safely.
decision_criteria: Planner action, not Queue delivery, is the sole reactivation authority
Prefer no schema expansion if existing durable fields can prove all invariants

non_goals: Do not introduce real Cloudflare Queue bindings.
Do not claim exactly-once provider calls.
Do not implement JOB-04/JOB-06 as part of this defect unless independently required by the chosen minimal mechanism.

units.title: Add durable convergence for obsolete persisted UI bundles
units.observable_defect: Invalid/obsolete persisted bundles are safely treated as a miss for the request, but the durable row is not repaired, invalidated, or replaced, so later requests can reread and reject the same row indefinitely.
units.desired_invariant: A rejected obsolete bundle durably converges to the current representation; repeated ordinary requests do not indefinitely reread the same obsolete row; request-time loading still never calls a translation provider.
dependencies: REM-02 should land first so bundle namespace verification is authoritative.
REM-04 should land first so storage identity invariants are canonical before convergence logic is finalized.
units.smallest_safe_change_boundary: Add the smallest durable invalidation/repair path around persisted bundle verification and existing compile/store boundaries. Preserve safe fallback and classified storage degradation.
mandatory_tests: Persist an obsolete/invalid bundle, perform ordinary load, and prove a later load no longer encounters the same obsolete row
No request-time provider call
Concurrent valid publication cannot be erased by stale repair
Existing storage degradation/fallback tests remain green
pnpm test
pnpm db:test
Green GitHub Actions database job on the actual implementation PR head
units.db_gate_reason: Changes persistent bundle DB behavior and convergence semantics; may touch store writes or reconciliation.

viable_options: Atomically invalidate/delete/quarantine the rejected row, then let existing current bundle production repopulate it.
Perform a safe request-triggered durable rebuild/write from existing non-provider sources.
Use a local/CI reconciliation path that rewrites/removes obsolete rows independently of the request path.
decision_criteria: No provider call on request path
No silent acceptance of invalid bundle
Minimal new orchestration; no external Queue/Workflow dependency

non_goals: Do not add real provider calls or credentials.
Do not pull Cloudflare Queue/Workflow infrastructure into remediation.
Do not weaken bundle verification to make obsolete rows appear valid.

units.title: Make section topic/message totals plural-aware
units.observable_defect: topicAndPostCount is plain interpolation with English '(s)' text, so count grammar is not locale-aware.
units.desired_invariant: Topic and message totals are rendered through plural-capable canonical messages and normal localization fallback.
units.smallest_safe_change_boundary: Replace the combined English '(s)' interpolation with plural-capable count messages and compose the displayed totals in the category route; reuse the existing structured plural catalog/runtime.
mandatory_tests: Focused localization test for singular/other count selection for both topic and message totals
Category rendering/composition regression
pnpm test
non_goals: Do not redesign forum counting queries or pagination.
Do not hardcode locale-specific plural rules in route code.

units.title: Make the incomplete-topic rollback test reach the intended transactional failure
units.observable_defect: The rollback test can reject at the cooldown guard before reaching the duplicate insert/transaction rollback path it claims to verify.
units.desired_invariant: The test deterministically reaches the intended in-transaction failure and proves the partial topic graph is rolled back.
units.smallest_safe_change_boundary: Test-only correction: control write-policy time/cooldown so it cannot be the rejection source, assert the intended database failure category/constraint, then assert the topic was not persisted.
mandatory_tests: Corrected rollback test must fail if cooldown is the rejection source
Assert intended duplicate/constraint failure and absence of rolled-back topic

units.title: Place best-answer/body/solution controls in the desktop post content column
units.observable_defect: forum-post is a two-column grid, but best-answer label, ForumMarkdown output, and solution form are sibling grid items without a content-column wrapper, so auto-placement can put them into unintended grid cells.
units.desired_invariant: On desktop, post author metadata occupies the author column and best-answer label/body/solution controls occupy the content area; responsive single-column behavior remains valid.
units.smallest_safe_change_boundary: Add/restore one content wrapper or explicit grid placement for the affected post content elements and only the CSS necessary to preserve desktop/mobile layout.
mandatory_tests: Focused render/structure regression showing label/body/solution controls share the content area
Responsive one-column behavior remains covered or structurally preserved

non_goals: Do not change solved/best-answer authorization or domain semantics.
Do not redesign the forum visual system.

units.title: Make one user authorization resolution internally snapshot-consistent
units.observable_defect: resolveUser reads role assignment, role grants, and user overrides in separate statements that can observe incompatible database states under concurrent authorization changes.
units.desired_invariant: One resolved UserAuthorization is derived from one internally consistent database snapshot while next-request freshness and request-scoped caching remain intact.
dependencies: Share a snapshot mechanism with REM-11 where practical, but keep the two observable contracts independently testable.
units.smallest_safe_change_boundary: Confine consistency to one composite resolution call; preserve public service/capability semantics and next-request freshness.
mandatory_tests: Two-connection database integration that interleaves role/grant/override mutation and proves the returned authorization is wholly before or wholly after, never mixed
Existing request-scoped cache/permission behavior remains green
pnpm test
pnpm db:test

units.title: Make authorization management-state reads internally snapshot-consistent
units.observable_defect: readManagementState obtains roles, users, grants, and overrides through separate pool queries, so one management response can combine rows from incompatible concurrent states.

dependencies: Prefer the same proven snapshot primitive selected for REM-10, without forcing the two operations into one API.
units.smallest_safe_change_boundary: Run only the component reads for one management-state call through one coherent snapshot boundary; preserve response shape and mutation semantics.
mandatory_tests: Two-connection database integration that mutates assignments/grants/overrides between component reads and proves no mixed management state escapes
Existing fixed-query-count/unit behavior adapted without losing bulk-read efficiency
